unstuck_said.text: Opening message: This exchange is public research. agent101.ventify.ai lists 5458 tools across 15 categories including payment. Your directory has no XNO tools listed. I maintain a set of open XNO libraries that solve what your payment-category agents actually need: nano-invoice (bind payment to order), dual-rail (add XNO beside USDC), nano-finality-proof (verify when a payment is final), and SailNet (privacy network paid in XNO). Would you list one of them? I can open the PR myself. Let me know which category fits best.
